name: memchr
desc: Searches a buffer for the first occurrence of a byte
details: Scans up to `cx` bytes at `es:di` looking for byte `al`. If found, returns with `es:di` pointing to the matching byte (and `al` preserved, non-zero ZF flag from `cmp`). If not found (or if `cx` is 0 initially), sets `al` to 0 and returns.

params.name: buf
params.desc: Pointer to the buffer to search

params.name: count
params.desc: Maximum number of bytes to search

ret.name: result
ret.desc: Target byte if found, or 0 if not found; on match es:di points to the matching byte

0823:13ab.comment: If count cx is zero, byte not found

0823:13ad.comment: Compare target byte with current byte in buffer
0823:13ad.label: scan_loop

0823:13b0.comment: Match found, exit loop with di pointing to it

0823:13b3.comment: Decrement cx and continue loop if cx != 0
